message.content:
This image is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. Below the title is the date "16-22 JUNI 2014". The cover features a central grayscale image of a hand clenched into a fist, except for the index finger, which is extended vertically. The tip of this finger is covered in green, brown, and yellow camouflage-patterned paint that appears to be dripping down.

Above the hand, large black text reads "ADA APA DENGAN TNI". Below this, smaller black text states: "Purnawirawan terbelah, benarkah ada persaingan antara Panglima TNI dan Kepala Staf Angkatan Darat?". 

At the top of the cover, additional text includes "ALOTNYA RENEGOSIASI FREEPORT" on the left and "LAPORAN KHUSUS: TAMBAL SULAM JAMINAN SOSIAL" on the right. A thin diagonal line separates these two phrases. A vertical red bar runs down the left edge of the cover. On the bottom right, there is a vertical barcode, the price "RP 35.000", and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO". All elements are set against a plain white background.
